name: office-space
description: Subagents as 16-bit office workers above the prompt, plus external workers from a watched folder. Toggle with /office-space.

workersDir.title: External workers folder
workersDir.description: Folder of worker JSON files to show in the office (OFFICE_SPACE_WORKERS_DIR overrides it).

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: An external worker not updated for this long is drawn faded; after 4x this long it leaves.

checkForUpdates.title: Check for updates daily
checkForUpdates.description: Once a day at session start, ask GitHub for the newest version and show one toast if there is one. Off by default; Office Space makes no network requests unless this is on or you run /office-space-update.

alertOnBlocked.title: Alert when a worker needs you
alertOnBlocked.description: Show a toast when an external worker becomes waiting or blocked: once each time it starts needing you, never repeated while it stays that way, and not for workers already waiting when the session starts. Works with the office closed.
